title: Biomass Power Plant Managers
description: Manage operations at biomass power generation facilities. Direct work activities at plant, including supervision of operations and maintenance staff.

tasks.text: Manage safety programs at power generation facilities.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical environment safety monitoring needs on-site sensing

tasks.text: Review biomass operations performance specifications to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Checks program against standards; human verifies compliance

dwas.name: Evaluate green operations or programs for compliance with standards or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Review logs, datasheets, or reports to ensure adequate production levels and safe production environments or to identify abnormalities with power production equipment or processes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Policy compliance document review, human owns final call

dwas.name: Monitor green energy equipment, systems, or facilities.
Review documents or materials for compliance with policies or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Supervise operations or maintenance employees in the production of power from biomass, such as wood, coal, paper sludge, or other waste or refuse.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing workers in the field is human supervision

dwas.name: Supervise workers performing environmentally sustainable activities.

tasks.text: Supervise biomass plant or substation operations, maintenance, repair, or testing activities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Plant operations direction needs real-time human control

dwas.name: Direct maintenance and repair activities in green energy production facilities.

tasks.text: Conduct field inspections of biomass plants, stations, or substations to ensure normal and safe operating conditions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Facility inspection requires physical presence and sensory judgment

dwas.name: Inspect operations of green energy facilities.

tasks.text: Plan and schedule plant activities, such as wood, waste, or refuse fuel deliveries, ash removal, and regular maintenance.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI arranges schedules; human manages real-world changes

dwas.name: Direct maintenance and repair activities in green energy production facilities.

tasks.text: Prepare and manage biomass plant budgets.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Green operational budget drafting from cost assumptions

dwas.name: Prepare operational budgets for green energy or other green operations.

tasks.text: Evaluate power production or demand trends to identify opportunities for improved operations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Energy production data evaluation is quantitative

tasks.text: Inspect biomass gasification processes, equipment, and facilities for ways to maximize capacity and minimize operating costs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Facility inspection requires physical presence and sensory judgment

dwas.name: Inspect operations of green energy facilities.

tasks.text: Prepare reports on biomass plant operations, status, maintenance, and other information.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts green energy communications; human reviews

dwas.name: Communicate green energy production information.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Manage parts and supply inventories for biomass plants.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Inventory management systems; human handles physical counts

dwas.name: Manage inventories of products or organizational resources.

tasks.text: Monitor and operate communications systems, such as mobile radios.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of green energy production equipment

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Compiling operational data from sources is automatable

tasks.text: Monitor the operating status of biomass plants by observing control system parameters, distributed control systems, switchboard gauges, dials, or other indicators.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Facility monitoring needs deployed sensors and physical inspection

dwas.name: Monitor green energy equipment, systems, or facilities.

tasks.text: Adjust equipment controls to generate specified amounts of electrical power.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of green energy production equipment

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Testing green tech installations requires physical setup

Perform manual service or maintenance tasks.
